Rooms.Name: On the beach
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the very western part of the beach. A rocky slope is 
to the west, making traveling there impossible. To the south you see the 
great Ocean.

Exits.Description: The beach continues to the east.
You see the shore to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the beach
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the sunny beach of Na-Palm. The soft white sand seems
to get inside all of your clothes. The beach continues to the west and the 
east. You see the shore to the south.

Exits.Description: The beach continues to the east.
You see the shore to the south.
The beach continues to the west.

Exits.Description: The beach continues to the east.
You see the shore to the south.
The beach continues to the west.

Rooms.Name: On the beach
Rooms.Description:
You are standing by a big rock providing shelter from the sun. To the south
you see the shore and the beach continues to the west.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the south.
The beach continues to the west.

Rooms.Name: On the shore
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the shore of the beach. You see the big waves rolling
in from the Mindorian Ocean, along with some flotsam from long forgotten
galleys.

Exits.Description: You see the Mindorian Ocean to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the shore
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the shore of the beach. Some kids have built the King's
Castle in the sand here.

Exits.Description: You see the Mindorian Ocean to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the shore
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the shore of the beach. As you look to the horizon to
the south you see a small black dot. Maybe it's one of those golden katamarans
from the far south that your father talked about when you were young.

Exits.Description: You see the Mindorian Ocean to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the wooden path to the pier
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the wooden path to the pier. All around you kids are 
playing beach volleyball and is throwing jelly-fishes at each other. To the 
east you see Captain Kidd's shop and to the south you see the pier.

Exits.Description: You see Captain Kidd's shop to the east.
You see the pier to the south.

Rooms.Name: Captain Kidd's Beach Shop
Rooms.Description:
You are at Captain Kidd's Beach Shop. Stacks of stranded goods lies here on
the white sand, things that the Captain seems to have found on the beach and
sells to stupid adventurers.

Exits.Description: You see the Mindorian Ocean to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the shore
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the shore of the beach. You see the big waves rolling in
from the Ocean to the south. A smashed barrel lies here, half buried in the 
sand.

Exits.Description: You see the Mindorian Ocean to the south.
You see Captain Kidd's shop to the west.

Rooms.Name: On the shore
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the shore of the beach. The wind from the south carries
scents of far away places.

Exits.Description: To the south you see the Mindorian Ocean.
You see the Captains beach shop to the west.

Rooms.Name: On the shore
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the shore of the beach. Dead jelly-fishes litter the 
ground here, dying of the burning sun.

Exits.Description: You see the Mindorian Ocean to the south.

Rooms.Name: In the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are standing knee-deep in the shallow water of the Mindorian Ocean. You
see small red fishes swimming around your boots, gasping at the sudden change
of their environment.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the north.

Rooms.Name: In the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are standing knee-deep in the shallow water of the Mindorian Ocean. The
ground here is filled with wreckage from long sunken canoes.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the north.

Rooms.Name: In the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are standing knee-deep in the shallow water of the Mindorian Ocean. To 
the south you see the great sea and to the east you see the pier.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the north.
You see the pier to the east.
The Ocean is to the south.

Rooms.Name: The pier
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the pier. The southern wind blows in your face, carrying
mystic scents and sounds from exotic places. The pier is build of black
granite, carried here by primates from a much more violent age.

Rooms.Name: In the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are standing knee-deep in the shallow water of the Mindorian Ocean. You
see a big wave rolling in, its getting closer ... To the north you see Captain
Kidd's beach shop.

Exits.Description: Captain Kidd's beach shop lies to the north.
You see the Great Sea to the south. The wave it rolling straight at you. ARGH!
You see the pier to the west.

Rooms.Name: In the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are standing knee-deep in the shallow water of the Mindorian Ocean. You
see a human skeleton partly covered in the sand. It must be Gregor, that ugly
mage apprentice that tried to walk on water. Guess he didn't make it.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the north.
The great sea lies out there.

Rooms.Name: In the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are standing knee-deep in the shallow water of the Mindorian Ocean. To
the south you see big wave rolling in from the Ocean.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the north.
The great sea lies to the south.

Rooms.Name: In the shallow water
Rooms.Description:
You are standing knee-deep in the shallow water of the Mindorian Ocean. The
southern wind ruffles your hair and has a scent of silt.

Exits.Description: You see the shore to the north.
The great sea lies to the south.

Rooms.Name: On deeper water
Rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. The water is dark and greenish blue so you
can't see the ground here. You hear the faint sound of the waves breaking 
against the beach to the north.

Exits.Description: You see Na-Palm beach to the north.
You see the horizon to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the high seas
Rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. The water looks so beautiful, glistening and
ever-changing, so dark and yet so transparent. A strong wind is blowing from
the south, filled with salt water. To the north you see barely see the Na-Palm
beach.

Exits.Description: You can barely see the Na-Palm beach to the north.

Rooms.Description:
You are on the Mindorian Ocean. The dark water swirls around your boat and
tosses it like a leaf in the wind. To the north you see a faint outline of a
coastline.

Exits.Description: You see a coastline to the north.

Rooms.Name: On the sandy path
Rooms.Description: You are on a sandy path that leads to Na-Palm beach to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the sandy path
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a sandy path that leads down to the sunny Na-Palm beach.
To the north you see the road that leads to Midgaard, the capital of this land.

Rooms.Name: On the road through the plains
Rooms.Description:
You are on a road through the plains. To the west and east of here young
saplings grows in small groups. To the north the road can take you to the city
of Midgaard. The road turns into a small sandy path to the south.

Rooms.Name: On the road through the plains
Rooms.Description:
You are on a road through the green plains south of Midgaard. All around you
the grass looks healthy and so green you almost think its artificial. The road
continues to the south.

Rooms.Name: On a bend on the road
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a road through the green, nice plains. To the north you
see a big black rock. It is quite out of place from the otherwise so friendly
and peaceful atmosphere. The road bends to the west from here.

Rooms.Name: On the road through the plains
Rooms.Description:
You are on the green plains south of Midgaard. The road bends to the east
here and far to the north you see the citywalls of Midgaard. Out of the 
corner of your eye you notice an ancient marker stone hidden in the 
undergrowth.

Exits.Description: A narrow overgrown trail leads west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You brush aside the bushes, and look at the marker. Its weathered 
surface indicate that it is very old, and the writing upon it is worn 
and difficult to read. An arrow points west, and above is the name 
'Delray'. Odd, the City of Delray disappeared centuries ago, presumed 
destroyed in a magical accident.

Rooms.Name: On the road through the plains
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a road through the plains. To the east you see a black
rock, eroded by the strong wind from the south. To the north you see the
citywalls of Midgaard and to the northeast is the graveyard.

Rooms.Name: On the road through the plains
Rooms.Description:
You are on a road through the plains just south of Midgaard. To the east you
see the west fence of the haunted graveyard. You see the white citywall to the
north.

Rooms.Name: City Entrance
Rooms.Description:
You stand on the outskirts of a large city - Midgaard; the capital of this  
land. To the north you see the big gate in the white city wall. To the east
you see the west fence of the haunted graveyard. To the south you see the 
southern plains of this continent.

Rooms.Name: Outside the South Gate of Midgaard
Rooms.Description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city wall and
connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate. To the south the
plains stretch out in the distance.

Exits.Description: You see the city gate.
You see the plains to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Both of the towers are built from large grey rocks that have been fastened to 
each other with some kind of mortar, just like the city wall.

It is built from large grey rocks that have been fastened to each other with
some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

It is a set of very big double doors made from hard wood.  They have been
reinforced with large iron bands to make them even more sturdy.  One of the
doors is equipped with a very big lock.

Rooms.Name: Inside the South Gate of Midgaard
Rooms.Description:
You are by two small towers that have been built into the city wall and
connected with a footbridge across the heavy wooden gate. To the north you see
the Emerald Avenue.

Exits.Description: You see Emerald Avenue to the north.
You see the gate.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a set of very big double doors made from hard wood.  They have been
reinforced with large iron bands to make them even more sturdy.  One of the
doors is equipped with a very big lock.

Rooms.Name: Overgrown trail
Rooms.Description:
You can barely make out the overgrown trail beneath your feet. 
Occasional stones poke up through the ground, their shape indicating 
that this was once a paved highway. It takes you a while to work out 
that the trail turns here.

Rooms.Name: A turn in the trail
Rooms.Description:
Spurts of dust kick up behind your feet as you shuffle your way 
through the dusty undergrowth. The road twists again here, you can go 
south or west.

Mobs.Name: crab
Mobs.LongDescription: A crab is crawling around here looking for toes to pinch.
Mobs.Description: The crab has a hard, brightly brown shell and two BIG pinchers.

Mobs.Name: fat man
Mobs.LongDescription: A fat man is sunbathing here.
Mobs.Description: His skin has a nice tan because he is using a new sun lotion.
Mobs.ActionScript: %10 say Go away! Can't you see i'm busy?!

Mobs.Name: mitch baywatch
Mobs.LongDescription: Mitch the Baywatch is standing here, trying to look muscular.
Mobs.Description: He is staring at the people bathing here, always ready to help a poor swimmer.
Mobs.ActionScript: %10 say Hello folks!;%10 emote looks at you.

Mobs.Name: fat woman
Mobs.LongDescription: A fat woman is sunbathing here.
Mobs.Description: She looks at you angrily as you are standing between her and the sun.

Mobs.Name: turtle
Mobs.LongDescription: A green turtle is crawling around on the beach here.
Mobs.Description: The turtle has an extremely hard and beautifull shell and a small head.

Mobs.Name: captain kidd
Mobs.LongDescription: Captain Kidd is here selling boats and icecreams.
Mobs.Description: He looks very mean and quite capable of chopping you to pieces if he wanted to.

Mobs.Name: surfer orc
Mobs.LongDescription: An orc surfer is here, riding the waves with some difficulty.
Mobs.Description:
The orc is surfing around on a surfing board made in the dark caves of moria.
As you watch him surfing around on the waves you notice that he is cursing the
dark water all the time.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%10 emote shudders at the sight of the water.;
%10 emote wobbles uneasily on his board.

Mobs.Name: surfer elf
Mobs.LongDescription: An elf surfer is riding the waves here.
Mobs.Description:
He is quite comfident in his ability in surfing the waves. His long blond hair
is ruffling in the wind as he make spectacular turns.

Mobs.Name: white shark big
Mobs.LongDescription: A big white fin just above the waterline is moving straight at you!
Mobs.Description:
Arghhh ! Suddenly you remember those old movies about this horrible creature.
The big white shark that killed hundreds of people bathing on nice beaches all
over the world.

Mobs.Name: seagull
Mobs.LongDescription: A seagull is flying around here.
Mobs.Description:
The seagull is circling around your head some 5 meters above you. It looks 
really angry and screams at you in a highpitched voice.

Objects.Name: shorts
Objects.Description: A pair of green worn-out shorts lies here on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The shorts are made of green polyester and has small pink elephants sewn into
it.

Objects.Name: sign pole
Objects.Description: You see a large sign on a pole here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It reads:
                               WARNING!!!
 The water here is the hunting-ground for big white sharks. Enter at your own
risk!

Objects.Name: bottle
Objects.Description: A bottle of dark glass lies here in the sand.

Objects.Name: paper old
Objects.Description: Someone have left an already used piece of paper here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
HELP! Im alone on an island in the middle of nowhere. The galley that i was 
travelling with sunk in a great storm. As far as i know i'm the only surivor. 
If you find me you will have my undying friendship and the pirate treasure 
that i have found.

Objects.Name: frisbee
Objects.Description: A frisbee lies here on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The frisbee is made of a light, yellow material. A small sign on it says: MADE
IN TAIWAN.

Objects.Name: sign
Objects.Description: An important sign is here on a pole.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Someone has written something on it. It reads:
You are standing on the very southern place of this land. To the south lies
the great Mindorian Ocean, and on the other side of it lies Kandoria.

Objects.Name: small boat wood
Objects.Description: A small boat made of wood lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Although its quite small you think it will be able to take you across the
Oceans.

Objects.Name: icecream magnum
Objects.Description: A tastylooking icecream with a thick layer of chocolade lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Ah! It's one of those famous swedish icecreams that you have only seen on TV
before. Its name is MAGNUM!
